title: Check Lane Activity Model for missing AI1 data causing default dimensions usage
summary: Use the Lane Activity Model to confirm whether AI1 is not sending data; the source example states this missing AI1 data can cause the system to use default dimensions.
when_to_use: When investigating a case where the system appears to be using default dimensions and you suspect AI1 is not providing recorded data, use the Lane Activity Model to verify AI1 data presence/absence.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Verify AI1 data presence in the Lane Activity Model and correlate it to whether default dimensions are being used (as described in the source example).
access_or_tools_needed: Lane Activity Model access (as referenced in the source)
Ability to view AI1-related data/recording status and dimension outputs within the Lane Activity Model UI

access_required: Access to the Lane Activity Model view referenced by the source

steps.purpose: Get to the recorded-data view where AI1 data presence can be checked.

steps.expected_result: The Lane Activity Model view is open and ready for checking AI1-related data/recording status.

steps.failure_condition: You cannot access the Lane Activity Model view or cannot locate any AI1-related data/recording status within it.

steps.purpose: Identify where the Lane Activity Model shows whether AI1 is sending/recording data.

steps.title: Verify whether AI1 is sending data
steps.purpose: Confirm the specific condition described by the source example: AI1 not sending data.
steps.instruction: Check the AI1-related status/data in the Lane Activity Model to determine whether AI1 is sending any data (i.e., whether it is recording/sending data).
steps.expected_result: You determine whether AI1 is sending data or not sending data based on the Lane Activity Model AI1 status/data.
steps.healthy_condition: AI1 status/data clearly indicates whether AI1 is sending data (present) or not sending data (missing/absent).
steps.failure_condition: AI1 status/data is ambiguous or contradicts the observed default-dimension behavior you are investigating.

actions.label: Check AI1 sending status
actions.exact_action: Verify whether AI1 is sending data; the source example states “AI1 was not sending any data.”

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Source evidence artifact associated with the segment includes the example: “AI one was not sending any data causing us to use default dimensions.”

steps.title: Correlate missing AI1 data with default dimensions usage
steps.purpose: Validate the source-described causal relationship: missing AI1 data leads to default dimensions being used.
steps.instruction: If the Lane Activity Model indicates AI1 is not sending data, confirm that the system behavior you are investigating aligns with default dimensions being used (as described in the source example).
steps.expected_result: When AI1 is not sending data, your investigation outcome matches the source example that default dimensions are used.
steps.healthy_condition: AI1 is not sending data in the Lane Activity Model, and the case you are troubleshooting shows default dimensions behavior consistent with the source example.
steps.failure_condition: AI1 appears to be sending data in the Lane Activity Model, but dimensions are still default; this indicates the issue is not explained by the AI1-missing condition described in the source.

actions.label: Correlate to default dimensions behavior
actions.exact_action: If AI1 is not sending data, note that the system is using default dimensions (as stated in the source example).

stop_or_escalate_if: If AI1 data appears present in the Lane Activity Model but dimensions are still default, escalate for deeper investigation beyond the source-described check.
